purpose: Build the pinned conditional theorem package in a disposable copy and audit all theorem assumptions without modifying the repository.
theorem_scope: A unit spatial tetrad direction gives a null photon under the explicit (-,+,+,+) quadratic form; this is not a full standard-boost proof.
The moving face formula specializes to a positive-frequency multiple of R_H only under a static line and grid.
Positive, negative, and zero upwind branches have the stated one-sided behavior; zero secants agree only when the traces agree.
Characteristic, red-face, and blue-face events use distinct constructors even if numerical guards vanish simultaneously.
The two-cell remap transcription satisfies its conditional number, constant-state, and JVP identities.
Signed distortion, total occupation, packet rate, and deposited occupation rate are separate structures with no implicit coercions.
The explicit packet deposition seam does not construct the missing scale, reference field, remap, or authority.

allowed_mutations: an output-only copy of the verified $REC_NEXT03_LEAN_WORKSPACE at $REC_NEXT03_LEAN_REBUILD_WORKSPACE outside the Git worktree
removal and regeneration of build outputs only inside the validated rebuild copy
runner-controlled Lake cache and build products only inside that rebuild copy
raw build, assumption, version, hash, and semantic receipts under caller-selected receipt directory
mutation_policy.precondition: Hash every checked-in Lean input, verify the source workspace identity, and record Git status before the output-only copy.
mutation_policy.postcondition: Checked-in inputs and the verified source workspace are byte-identical and unmodified; all build mutations occurred only in the rebuild copy.

steps: run lake clean for the root package inside the rebuild workspace
structurally enumerate root and materialized package build directories from Lake configuration and the manifest
reject any build directory that is a symlink or whose canonical path is not a descendant of the rebuild workspace
remove each validated build directory inside the rebuild workspace only
assert no .olean, .ilean, .volean, or .trace file remains anywhere under the rebuild workspace
reject any artifact-cache restore, download, unpack, or reuse path; post-reset compiled artifacts may appear only as outputs of the recorded rebuild commands

build_phases.required_result: mathlib and transitive dependency artifacts rebuilt from the verified materialized source copy
RecNext03 aggregate compiles against artifacts produced by CLEAN_DEPENDENCY_REBUILD

scan_semantics: blank nested Lean block-comment contents while preserving offsets and line numbers
blank Lean line-comment and double-quoted string contents while preserving offsets and line numbers
case-insensitive whole-word scan for sorry and admit in the remaining code-shaped text
case-insensitive line-anchored scan for axiom/axioms and constant/constants after optional private/protected prefixes
static_rejection.scan_pass_is_not_sufficient: namespace-isolated rebuild and exact 25-theorem assumption audit are also required

semantic_projection_fields: unique mathlib manifest entry inputRev and rev
source and rebuild workspace absolute canonical paths and byte-identity result
mathlib package Git HEAD, HEAD tree, remote origin URL, and clean status before and after copy
prebuild build-output reset inventory and zero compiled-artifact assertion
top-level environment_boundary.cleared_lean_cache_overrides and environment_boundary.effective_lean_cache_controls with LAKE_NO_CACHE=1, LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false, and LAKE_RESTORE_ARTIFACTS=0
Lean backend cache_policy.cleared_inherited, cache_policy.effective, and empty cache_policy.build_log_cache_reuse_findings
top-level network_isolation with mechanism, executable, probe command/exit_code/stdout_log/stderr_log/timed_out, exact interface list, verified flag, and reason
namespace-isolated clean dependency rebuild command and exit code
rebuilt mathlib and transitive dependency artifact inventory and SHA-256
namespace-isolated aggregate compile command and exit code
cleared inherited search-path variables and effective runner-controlled paths
assumptions sorted by declaration then assumption
pass_requirements: exact pinned Lean and mathlib versions
unique structurally parsed lakefile and manifest mathlib entries resolve tag v4.33.0 to commit db584cd6d46c92f209a44c0f1c829460d327499d
materialized mathlib checkout HEAD matches the locked commit, is clean, and its HEAD tree is recorded

verified source workspace may be inside a Git checkout but its checked formal bytes, materialized mathlib HEAD/tree/clean identity, and complete before/after tree seal all pass while an output-only rebuild copy is used
the rebuild workspace is outside every Git worktree and confined to the selected output directory
all prior workspace and package build outputs are removed in the rebuild copy and no pre-materialized Lean compiled artifact remains
all inherited Lean artifact-cache controls are cleared, the required effective cache-disable values are recorded, and no cached compiled artifact is restored, unpacked, or reused
the unshare Linux user/network namespace preflight exits zero, reports exactly the loopback interface, and is recorded as verified
every tool subprocess uses the exact verified namespace prefix; proxy and Git URL rewrite controls alone never satisfy this requirement
namespace-isolated lake build @mathlib succeeds and rebuilt dependency artifact hashes are recorded
namespace-isolated lake build @/RecNext03 succeeds against those rebuilt artifacts
no local constant, axiom, sorry, or admit
exact 25-theorem assumption audit with only the narrow foundation allowlist

fail_closed: Do not execute lake update or perform dependency resolution during this verification.
Do not run any version, Git identity, clean/reset, build, or assumption-audit subprocess unless the unshare Linux user/network namespace preflight is verified with exactly the loopback interface.

Do not treat dead proxy variables or Git URL rewrites as proof of network isolation; if unshare is missing, denied, exits nonzero, or exposes any interface other than lo, return ENVIRONMENT_GAP_NETWORK_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE_NOT_PASS before tool execution.
Do not report PASS if the manifest, unique inputRev/tag+rev mapping, materialized mathlib Git HEAD, clean status, or tree receipt is missing or mismatched.
Do not build directly in or mutate the verified source workspace.

Do not reject a verified source workspace solely because it is inside a Git checkout; instead require its byte, materialized-mathlib identity, and unchanged seals. The rebuild workspace remains forbidden inside every Git worktree.
Do not trust, reuse, or accept a pre-materialized .olean, .ilean, .volean, trace, release build, or cache artifact from the source workspace or copied package trees.
Do not treat LAKE_NO_CACHE=1 alone as sufficient; require and record LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false and LAKE_RESTORE_ARTIFACTS=0 after clearing every inherited artifact-cache override.
Do not restore, download, unpack, or reuse a cached .olean, .ilean, .volean, trace, or equivalent Lean compiled artifact; any such path is FAIL_NOT_PASS.
Do not report PASS unless dependency outputs were purged in the output-only rebuild copy, rebuilt under the verified namespace, inventoried, and then consumed by the aggregate compile.
Do not inherit any language, package, cache, or userbase override listed in execution.environment_policy.clear_inherited; only captured runner-controlled paths are permitted.
Do not weaken a theorem or add an axiom to obtain a build.
Do not treat tagged variable or unit separation as a constructed physical adapter.
Do not treat an algebraic theorem as source bytes, implementation parity, production admission, or scientific evidence.
Do not modify the checked-in Lake package during evidence-producing execution.
